gap_sentence: Agentio is betting that creator ads can be bought and measured like Meta or Google ads, and no one outside the company has yet shown that its numbers hold; the job is to tell that story in words a performance marketer trusts before the proof is public.

cards.title: Positioning & messaging, said so it shows

cards.what: Deciding how the product is described: to whom, against what alternative, and why it is better, in words customers repeat.
cards.reads_as: The core craft: positioning statements, messaging hierarchies and the words of the brand.
cards.prompt:
I am rewriting one line of my résumé for a Product Marketing Manager role. The skill the line should show is "Positioning & messaging": Deciding how the product is described: to whom, against what alternative, and why it is better, in words customers repeat.
In Marketing, it means: The core craft: positioning statements, messaging hierarchies and the words of the brand.
The line today reads: "Wrote the discovery-call guide and the objection sheet the sales team used; kept both current after every pricing or packaging change". An automatic reader marks it "shown in another field's words".
A line that shows it names the thing produced (positioning statement, messaging hierarchy or value proposition); starts with a verb like positioned, wrote the messaging for or repositioned; says who it was with (marketing, sales or design); gives a measure (conversion or win-rate change or launches messaged).
Ask me three questions about what I actually did, one at a time. Then draft three versions of the line, each under 30 words, in the past tense. Never invent a number or a name: write [ ] where I must fill one in.

cards.title: A six-week brief for DTC marketers on buying creator ads like a performance channel
cards.ship: Six weekly issues, published on a public page with an email list, each turning one public measurement fact into something a performance marketer can use (engaged views and the 67% overpay, 90-day amortization, post-purchase surveys, the 1.5x to 3x pixel multiplier, Meta creative fatigue at 36 days, the IAB measurement landscape), with Agentio's and competitors' public material as the sources; the sixth issue is a reader survey and a changelog of what readers corrected.

cards.title: Claimkeeper: an enablement library where every number knows its source
cards.ship: A small product for seed-to-Series-B marketing teams: every claim in a deck, one-pager or battlecard is linked to the launch brief and the public source it came from; when a source changes (a pricing page, a case study, a platform policy), the assets that carry the claim are flagged stale and the owner gets the rewrite queue; built with an LLM that checks each claim against its source, and shipped first to three startups' PMMs.

why_role.text: The posting makes the enablement system itself a deliverable the role owns, with a one-week freshness rule. A tool that keeps that rule turns the role's second half into a product.
why_role.posting_quote: The enablement system itself: one asset library, every asset current whenever product, pricing or packaging changes

why_company.text: Agentio's claims change with every launch and every platform policy change. YouTube's August 2026 view-count change forced an engaged-view restatement within a week. The company treats an inaccurate claim as a reputational risk. The problem is theirs before it is anyone's.

why_person.text: Keeping sales material current after every pricing change was her job for three years, by hand. She knows the failure mode the product removes.
why_person.profile_quote: kept both current after every pricing or packaging change

cards.users: Product marketers and founders at marketing-led startups between seed and Series B, met through the Cornell Tech startup studio, the fellowship's founder network and the Shopify partner community; the first three design partners are chosen for having a sales deck older than their pricing.
